generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// ============================================================
// SAAS PLATFORM
// ============================================================

enum PlanInterval {
  MONTHLY
  YEARLY
  LIFETIME
}

enum SubscriptionStatus {
  ACTIVE
  SUSPENDED
  CANCELLED
  EXPIRED
}

model SaaSPlan {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String   @unique
  description String?
  price       Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency    String   @default("DZD")
  interval    PlanInterval
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  modules       SaaSPlanModule[]
  features      SaaSPlanFeature[]
  subscriptions TenantSubscription[]
}

model SaaSModule {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String   @unique
  code        String   @unique
  description String?
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  plans       SaaSPlanModule[]
  permissions SaaSPermission[]
}

model SaaSPermission {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  moduleId    String
  module      SaaSModule  @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])
  name        String
  code        String   @unique
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  rolePermissions RolePermission[]
}

model SaaSPlanModule {
  planId   String
  plan     SaaSPlan   @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  moduleId String
  module   SaaSModule @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([planId, moduleId])
}

model SaaSPlanFeature {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  planId      String
  plan        SaaSPlan @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  code        String
  value       String
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([planId, code])
}

model TenantSubscription {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId    String
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  planId      String
  plan        SaaSPlan @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  status      SubscriptionStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  startDate   DateTime
  endDate     DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([tenantId])
}

model TenantPlanFeatureOverride {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId    String
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  featureCode String
  value       String
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([tenantId, featureCode])
}

// ============================================================
// TENANTS & ESTABLISHMENTS
// ============================================================

enum EstablishmentCategory {
  DAYCARE
  SCHOOL
  MIDDLE_SCHOOL
  HIGH_SCHOOL
  UNIVERSITY
}

model Tenant {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @unique
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  establishments          Establishment[]
  subscriptions           TenantSubscription[]
  planFeatureOverrides    TenantPlanFeatureOverride[]
}

model Establishment {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId    String
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  name        String
  slug        String   @unique
  category    EstablishmentCategory
  country     String   @default("DZ")
  timezone    String   @default("Africa/Algiers")
  logo        String?
  address     String?
  phone       String?
  email       String?
  website     String?
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  configs              EstablishmentConfig[]
  academicYears        AcademicYear[]
  classes              Class[]
  academicModules      AcademicModule[]
  matieres             Matiere[]
  rooms                Room[]
  holidays             Holiday[]
  smtpConfigs          SmtpConfig[]
  notificationConfigs  NotificationConfig[]
  paymentConfigs       PaymentConfig[]
  gradingConfigs       GradingConfig[]
  students             Student[]
  teachers             Teacher[]
  employees            Employee[]
  parents              Parent[]
  paymentPlans         PaymentPlan[]
  caisses              Caisse[]
  exams                Exam[]

  @@index([tenantId])
}

// ============================================================
// USERS & AUTH
// ============================================================

enum Gender {
  MALE
  FEMALE
  OTHER
}

enum Month {
  JANUARY
  FEBRUARY
  MARCH
  APRIL
  MAY
  JUNE
  JULY
  AUGUST
  SEPTEMBER
  OCTOBER
  NOVEMBER
  DECEMBER
}

model User {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid())
  email         String?   @unique
  username      String?   @unique
  password      String
  firstName     String
  lastName      String
  phone         String?
  avatar        String?
  isActive      Boolean   @default(true)
  isRoot        Boolean   @default(false)
  lastLoginAt   DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  tenant           Tenant?
  userRoles        UserRoleAssignment[]
  auditLogs        AuditLog[]
  loginLogs        LoginLog[]
  sentMessages     Message[]    @relation("Sender")
  receivedMessages Message[]    @relation("Receiver")
  notifications    Notification[]
}

model Role {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String   @unique
  code        String   @unique
  description String?
  isSystem    Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  permissions RolePermission[]
  userRoles   UserRoleAssignment[]
}

model UserRoleAssignment {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  roleId          String
  role            Role     @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id])
  establishmentId String?
  establishment   Establishment? @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, roleId, establishmentId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([roleId])
  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model RolePermission {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  roleId       String
  role         Role     @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id])
  permissionId String
  permission   SaaSPermission @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id])
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([roleId, permissionId])
}

model LoginLog {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?
  success   Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
}

// ============================================================
// ESTABLISHMENT CONFIGURATION
// ============================================================

enum GradingScaleType {
  NUMERIC
  LETTER
  PERCENTAGE
  CUSTOM
}

enum PeriodType {
  TRIMESTER
  SEMESTER
}

enum PaymentMethod {
  CASH
  CHECK
  STRIPE
  PAYPAL
  VISA
  MASTERCARD
  AMERICAN_EXPRESS
  BANK_TRANSFER
}

enum ContractType {
  HOURLY
  MONTHLY
  YEARLY
  PER_FORMATION
  PER_SESSION
  CUSTOM
}

model EstablishmentConfig {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String   @unique
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  defaultLanguage String   @default("fr")
  defaultCurrency String   @default("DZD")
  academicYearStart Month  @default(SEPTEMBER)
  maxAbsencesBeforeNotify Int @default(3)
  allowOnlineExams Boolean @default(false)
  enableAntiCheating Boolean @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
}

model GradingConfig {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  classLevelId    String?
  name            String
  scaleType       GradingScaleType
  minScore        Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(0)
  maxScore        Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(20)
  passThreshold   Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(10)
  gradeLabels     Json?
  isDefault       Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  classes Class[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model SmtpConfig {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  host            String
  port            Int
  user            String
  password        String
  fromName        String
  fromEmail       String
  isSecure        Boolean  @default(true)
  isDefault       Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model NotificationConfig {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String   @unique
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  enableEmail     Boolean  @default(true)
  enableInApp     Boolean  @default(true)
  absenceThreshold Int     @default(3)
  paymentReminderDays Int  @default(7)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
}

model PaymentConfig {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  allowedMethods  PaymentMethod[]
  stripeKey       String?
  stripeSecret    String?
  paypalClientId  String?
  paypalSecret    String?
  latePenaltyPercent Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  latePenaltyEnabled Boolean @default(false)
  blockAccessOnLate  Boolean @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

// ============================================================
// ACADEMIC STRUCTURE
// ============================================================

model AcademicYear {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  startDate       DateTime
  endDate         DateTime
  isCurrent       Boolean  @default(false)
  isClosed        Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  periods                    AcademicPeriod[]
  classes                    Class[]
  studentClassAssignments    StudentClassAssignment[]
  notes                      Note[]
  exams                      Exam[]
  sessions                   Session[]
  graduationRecords          GraduationRecord[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
  @@unique([establishmentId, name])
}

model AcademicPeriod {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  academicYearId String
  academicYear   AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  name           String
  type           PeriodType
  startDate      DateTime
  endDate        DateTime
  isCurrent      Boolean  @default(false)
  sortOrder      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  notes          Note[]
  exams          Exam[]
  sessions       Session[]
  classSchedules ClassSchedule[]

  @@index([academicYearId])
}

model ClassLevel {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String   @unique
  description String?
  sortOrder   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  classes         Class[]
  gradingConfigs  GradingConfig[]
}

model Class {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  classLevelId    String
  classLevel      ClassLevel @relation(fields: [classLevelId], references: [id])
  academicYearId  String
  academicYear    AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  gradingConfigId String?
  gradingConfig   GradingConfig? @relation(fields: [gradingConfigId], references: [id])
  name            String
  code            String?
  periodType      PeriodType
  maxStudents     Int      @default(30)
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  schedules              ClassSchedule[]
  sessions               Session[]
  studentClassAssignments StudentClassAssignment[]
  exams                  Exam[]
  moduleAssignments      ClassModuleAssignment[]
  graduationRecordsFrom  GraduationRecord[] @relation("FromClass")
  graduationRecordsTo    GraduationRecord[] @relation("ToClass")

  @@index([establishmentId])
  @@index([academicYearId])
  @@index([classLevelId])
  @@unique([establishmentId, academicYearId, name])
}

model ClassModuleAssignment {
  id        String @id @default(uuid())
  classId   String
  class     Class  @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  moduleId  String
  module    AcademicModule @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([classId, moduleId])
}

model AcademicModule {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  code            String?
  description     String?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  matieres         Matiere[]
  classAssignments ClassModuleAssignment[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model Matiere {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  moduleId    String
  module      AcademicModule @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])
  name        String
  code        String?
  coefficient Decimal  @db.Decimal(3, 1) @default(1.0)
  maxScore    Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(20)
  description String?
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  lessons           Lesson[]
  notes             Note[]
  exams             Exam[]
  teacherMatieres   TeacherMatiere[]
  classSchedules    ClassSchedule[]

  @@index([moduleId])
}

// ============================================================
// PEOPLE: STUDENTS, PARENTS, TEACHERS, EMPLOYEES
// ============================================================

model Student {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId   String
  establishment     Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  userId            String?  @unique
  user              User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  firstName         String
  lastName          String
  dateOfBirth       DateTime?
  gender            Gender?
  phone             String?
  address           String?
  photo             String?
  registrationNumber String  @unique
  isActive          Boolean  @default(true)
  enrollmentDate    DateTime @default(now())
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt

  classAssignments StudentClassAssignment[]
  attendances      StudentAttendance[]
  notes            Note[]
  bulletins        Bulletin[]
  payments         StudentPayment[]
  parents          StudentParent[]
  examSubmissions  ExamSubmission[]
  graduationRecords GraduationRecord[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
  @@index([registrationNumber])
}

model Parent {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  userId          String?  @unique
  user            User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  firstName       String
  lastName        String
  phone           String?
  email           String?
  address         String?
  occupation      String?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  students  StudentParent[]
  payments  StudentPayment[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model StudentParent {
  id        String @id @default(uuid())
  studentId String
  student   Student @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  parentId  String
  parent    Parent  @relation(fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  relation  String  @default("parent")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([studentId, parentId])
}

model StudentClassAssignment {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId       String
  student         Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  classId         String
  class           Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  academicYearId  String
  academicYear    AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  isPromoted      Boolean?
  assignedAt      DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([studentId, academicYearId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([classId])
  @@index([academicYearId])
}

model Teacher {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  userId          String?  @unique
  user            User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  firstName       String
  lastName        String
  phone           String?
  email           String?
  address         String?
  photo           String?
  specialization  String?
  hireDate        DateTime @default(now())
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  contracts     TeacherContract[]
  attendances   TeacherAttendance[]
  matieres      TeacherMatiere[]
  sessions      Session[]
  leaves        TeacherLeave[]
  schedules     ClassSchedule[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model TeacherMatiere {
  id        String @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId String
  teacher   Teacher @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  matiereId String
  matiere   Matiere @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([teacherId, matiereId])
}

model TeacherContract {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId       String
  teacher         Teacher  @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  contractType    ContractType
  startDate       DateTime
  endDate         DateTime?
  salary          Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  hourlyRate      Decimal? @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  monthlyHours    Int?
  paymentFormula  Json?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  description     String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  payments TeacherPayment[]

  @@index([teacherId])
}

model Employee {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  userId          String?  @unique
  user            User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  firstName       String
  lastName        String
  phone           String?
  email           String?
  position        String
  hireDate        DateTime @default(now())
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

// ============================================================
// ROOMS
// ============================================================

enum RoomType {
  CLASSROOM
  LABORATORY
  LIBRARY
  GYM
  AUDITORIUM
  COMPUTER_LAB
  ART_ROOM
  MUSIC_ROOM
  OTHER
}

model Room {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  code            String?
  type            RoomType
  capacity        Int
  floor           Int?
  building        String?
  description     String?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  equipment RoomEquipment[]
  sessions  Session[]
  schedules ClassSchedule[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model RoomEquipment {
  id       String @id @default(uuid())
  roomId   String
  room     Room   @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id])
  name     String
  quantity Int    @default(1)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([roomId])
}

// ============================================================
// CALENDAR & SESSIONS
// ============================================================

enum DayOfWeek {
  MONDAY
  TUESDAY
  WEDNESDAY
  THURSDAY
  FRIDAY
  SATURDAY
  SUNDAY
}

enum SessionStatus {
  SCHEDULED
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
  CANCELLED
}

model ClassSchedule {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  classId     String
  class       Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  periodId    String
  period      AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  dayOfWeek   DayOfWeek
  startTime   DateTime
  endTime     DateTime
  matiereId   String?
  matiere     Matiere? @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  teacherId   String?
  teacher     Teacher? @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  roomId      String?
  room        Room?    @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id])
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  sessions Session[]

  @@index([classId])
  @@index([periodId])
  @@index([teacherId])
  @@index([roomId])
}

model Session {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  classId        String
  class          Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  scheduleId     String?
  schedule       ClassSchedule? @relation(fields: [scheduleId], references: [id])
  periodId       String
  period         AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  academicYearId String
  academicYear   AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  date           DateTime
  startTime      DateTime
  endTime        DateTime
  topic          String?
  notes          String?
  status         SessionStatus @default(SCHEDULED)
  teacherId      String?
  teacher        Teacher? @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  roomId         String?
  room           Room?    @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id])
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  attendances StudentAttendance[]
  lessons     Lesson[]

  @@index([classId])
  @@index([periodId])
  @@index([academicYearId])
  @@index([teacherId])
}

model Holiday {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  startDate       DateTime
  endDate         DateTime
  isRecurring     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

// ============================================================
// LESSONS, NOTES, EXAMS
// ============================================================

model Lesson {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  sessionId String
  session   Session  @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id])
  matiereId String
  matiere   Matiere  @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  title     String
  content   String?
  objectives String?
  resources Json?
  createdBy String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([sessionId])
  @@index([matiereId])
}

model Note {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId      String
  student        Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  matiereId      String
  matiere        Matiere  @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  periodId       String
  period         AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  academicYearId String
  academicYear   AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  examId         String?
  exam           Exam?    @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id])
  value          Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  maxValue       Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  coefficient    Decimal  @db.Decimal(3, 1)
  comment        String?
  gradedBy       String?
  gradedAt       DateTime @default(now())
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([studentId, matiereId, periodId, examId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([matiereId])
  @@index([periodId])
}

model Bulletin {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId     String
  student       Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  periodId      String
  period        AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  classId       String
  class         Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  totalScore    Decimal  @db.Decimal(6, 2)
  averageScore  Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  rank          Int?
  isPromoted    Boolean?
  comments      String?
  generatedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  generatedBy   String?

  @@unique([studentId, periodId, classId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([classId])
}

enum ExamType {
  QUIZ
  MIDTERM
  FINAL
  HOMEWORK
  PRACTICAL
  OTHER
}

enum ExamStatus {
  DRAFT
  SCHEDULED
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
  GRADED
}

enum QuestionType {
  QCM
  FREE_TEXT
  FILE_UPLOAD
  TRUE_FALSE
  SHORT_ANSWER
}

enum SubmissionStatus {
  IN_PROGRESS
  SUBMITTED
  GRADED
  LATE
}

model Exam {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  classId         String
  class           Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  periodId        String
  period          AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  academicYearId  String
  academicYear    AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  matiereId       String
  matiere         Matiere  @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  title           String
  description     String?
  type            ExamType
  isOnline        Boolean  @default(false)
  maxScore        Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(20)
  duration        Int?
  startTime       DateTime?
  endTime         DateTime?
  status          ExamStatus @default(DRAFT)
  antiCheat       Boolean  @default(false)
  maxAttempts     Int      @default(1)
  createdBy       String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  questions   ExamQuestion[]
  submissions ExamSubmission[]
  notes       Note[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
  @@index([classId])
  @@index([periodId])
  @@index([matiereId])
}

model ExamQuestion {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  examId    String
  exam      Exam     @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id])
  type      QuestionType
  content   String
  options   Json?
  maxScore  Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  sortOrder Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  answers ExamAnswer[]

  @@index([examId])
}

model ExamSubmission {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  examId      String
  exam        Exam     @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id])
  studentId   String
  student     Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  startedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  submittedAt DateTime?
  totalScore  Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  status      SubmissionStatus @default(IN_PROGRESS)
  ipAddress   String?
  tabSwitches Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  answers ExamAnswer[]

  @@unique([examId, studentId])
  @@index([studentId])
}

model ExamAnswer {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  submissionId String
  submission   ExamSubmission @relation(fields: [submissionId], references: [id])
  questionId   String
  question     ExamQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id])
  answer       String?
  fileUrl      String?
  score        Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  isCorrect    Boolean?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([submissionId])
  @@index([questionId])
}

// ============================================================
// ATTENDANCE
// ============================================================

enum AttendanceStatus {
  PRESENT
  ABSENT
  LATE
  EXCUSED
}

enum AttendanceSource {
  MANUAL
  AUTO_LOGIN
  QR_CODE
}

enum LeaveType {
  SICK
  PERSONAL
  VACATION
  MATERNITY
  OTHER
}

enum LeaveStatus {
  PENDING
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

model StudentAttendance {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId String
  student   Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  sessionId String
  session   Session  @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id])
  status    AttendanceStatus
  reason    String?
  markedBy  String?
  markedAt  DateTime @default(now())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([studentId, sessionId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([sessionId])
}

model TeacherAttendance {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId String
  teacher   Teacher  @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  date      DateTime
  checkIn   DateTime?
  checkOut  DateTime?
  status    AttendanceStatus
  source    AttendanceSource @default(MANUAL)
  markedBy  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([teacherId, date])
  @@index([teacherId])
}

model TeacherLeave {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId String
  teacher   Teacher  @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  type      LeaveType
  startDate DateTime
  endDate   DateTime
  reason    String?
  status    LeaveStatus @default(PENDING)
  approvedBy String?
  approvedAt DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([teacherId])
}

// ============================================================
// PAYMENTS & FINANCE
// ============================================================

enum PaymentPlanType {
  ONE_TIME
  RECURRING
  ENROLLMENT
  TUITION
  CUSTOM
}

enum RecurringPeriod {
  MONTHLY
  QUARTERLY
  SEMESTER
  YEARLY
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  PARTIAL
  OVERDUE
  CANCELLED
  REFUNDED
}

enum CaisseType {
  MAIN
  TUITION
  SALARY
  PETTY_CASH
}

enum TransactionType {
  INCOME
  EXPENSE
  TRANSFER
  REFUND
  PENALTY
}

model PaymentPlan {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  description     String?
  classLevelId    String?
  classId         String?
  type            PaymentPlanType
  amount          Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  dueDate         DateTime?
  recurringPeriod RecurringPeriod?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  startDate       DateTime?
  endDate         DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  payments StudentPayment[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model StudentPayment {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId       String
  student         Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  parentId        String
  parent          Parent   @relation(fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  planId          String?
  plan            PaymentPlan? @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  amount          Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  method          PaymentMethod
  status          PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  dueDate         DateTime?
  paidAt          DateTime?
  reference       String?
  stripePaymentId String?
  paypalPaymentId String?
  checkNumber     String?
  notes           String?
  penaltyAmount   Decimal? @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  createdBy       String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([parentId])
  @@index([planId])
}

model TeacherPayment {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId       String
  teacher         Teacher  @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  contractId      String
  contract        TeacherContract @relation(fields: [contractId], references: [id])
  period          String
  amount          Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  hoursWorked     Decimal? @db.Decimal(6, 2)
  calculatedAmount Decimal @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  status          PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  paidAt          DateTime?
  notes           String?
  createdBy       String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([teacherId])
  @@index([contractId])
}

model Caisse {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  type            CaisseType
  balance         Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2) @default(0)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  description     String?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  transactions FinancialTransaction[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model FinancialTransaction {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  caisseId      String
  caisse        Caisse   @relation(fields: [caisseId], references: [id])
  type          TransactionType
  amount        Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  balance       Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  category      String?
  description   String?
  referenceId   String?
  referenceType String?
  performedBy   String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([caisseId])
  @@index([type])
}

model ProfitLoss {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  period          String
  totalIncome     Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2) @default(0)
  totalExpenses   Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2) @default(0)
  netProfit       Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2) @default(0)
  calculatedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([establishmentId, period])
  @@index([establishmentId])
}

// ============================================================
// MESSAGING & NOTIFICATIONS
// ============================================================

enum ConversationType {
  DIRECT
  GROUP
  ANNOUNCEMENT
}

enum MessageType {
  TEXT
  IMAGE
  FILE
  SYSTEM
}

enum NotificationType {
  IN_APP
  EMAIL
  SMS
}

model Conversation {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  title     String?
  type      ConversationType @default(DIRECT)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  participants ConversationParticipant[]
  messages     Message[]
}

model ConversationParticipant {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  conversationId  String
  conversation    Conversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id])
  userId          String
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  joinedAt        DateTime @default(now())
  lastReadAt      DateTime?

  @@unique([conversationId, userId])
  @@index([conversationId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Message {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  conversationId  String
  conversation    Conversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id])
  senderId        String
  sender          User     @relation("Sender", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  receiverId      String?
  receiver        User?    @relation("Receiver", fields: [receiverId], references: [id])
  content         String
  type            MessageType @default(TEXT)
  fileUrl         String?
  isRead          Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([conversationId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@index([receiverId])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  title     String
  content   String
  type      NotificationType
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false)
  link      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
}

model NotificationTemplate {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  code      String   @unique
  name      String
  subject   String?
  body      String
  type      NotificationType
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

// ============================================================
// AUDIT & GRADUATION
// ============================================================

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String?
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String
  entity    String
  entityId  String?
  oldValues Json?
  newValues Json?
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([entity, entityId])
  @@index([action])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model GraduationConfig {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  classId         String
  class           Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  minAverageToPass Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(10)
  autoPromote     Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([establishmentId, classId])
}

model GraduationRecord {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId      String
  student        Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  fromClassId    String
  fromClass      Class    @relation("FromClass", fields: [fromClassId], references: [id])
  toClassId      String?
  toClass        Class?   @relation("ToClass", fields: [toClassId], references: [id])
  academicYearId String
  academicYear   AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  averageScore   Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  isPromoted     Boolean
  reason         String?
  processedBy    String?
  processedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([studentId, academicYearId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([fromClassId])
  @@index([academicYearId])
}

model SaaSPlanModule {

model PaymentConfig {

// ACADEMIC STRUCTURE

model AcademicYear {

  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  startDate       DateTime
  endDate         DateTime
  isCurrent       Boolean  @default(false)
  isClosed        Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  periods                    AcademicPeriod[]
  classes                    Class[]
  studentClassAssignments    StudentClassAssignment[]
  notes                      Note[]
  exams                      Exam[]
  sessions                   Session[]
  graduationRecords          GraduationRecord[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
  @@unique([establishmentId, name])
}

model AcademicPeriod {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  academicYearId String
  academicYear   AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  name           String
  type           PeriodType
  startDate      DateTime
  endDate        DateTime
  isCurrent      Boolean  @default(false)
  sortOrder      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  notes          Note[]
  exams          Exam[]
  sessions       Session[]
  classSchedules ClassSchedule[]

  @@index([academicYearId])
}

model ClassLevel {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String   @unique
  description String?
  sortOrder   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  classes         Class[]
  gradingConfigs  GradingConfig[]
}

model Class {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  classLevelId    String
  classLevel      ClassLevel @relation(fields: [classLevelId], references: [id])
  academicYearId  String
  academicYear    AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  gradingConfigId String?
  gradingConfig   GradingConfig? @relation(fields: [gradingConfigId], references: [id])
  name            String
  code            String?
  periodType      PeriodType
  maxStudents     Int      @default(30)
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  schedules              ClassSchedule[]
  sessions               Session[]
  studentClassAssignments StudentClassAssignment[]
  exams                  Exam[]
  moduleAssignments      ClassModuleAssignment[]
  graduationRecordsFrom  GraduationRecord[] @relation("FromClass")
  graduationRecordsTo    GraduationRecord[] @relation("ToClass")

  @@index([establishmentId])
  @@index([academicYearId])
  @@index([classLevelId])
  @@unique([establishmentId, academicYearId, name])
}

model ClassModuleAssignment {
  id        String @id @default(uuid())
  classId   String
  class     Class  @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  moduleId  String
  module    AcademicModule @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([classId, moduleId])
}

model AcademicModule {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  code            String?
  description     String?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  matieres         Matiere[]
  classAssignments ClassModuleAssignment[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model Matiere {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  moduleId    String
  module      AcademicModule @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])
  name        String
  code        String?
  coefficient Decimal  @db.Decimal(3, 1) @default(1.0)
  maxScore    Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(20)
  description String?
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  lessons           Lesson[]
  notes             Note[]
  exams             Exam[]
  teacherMatieres   TeacherMatiere[]
  classSchedules    ClassSchedule[]

  @@index([moduleId])
}

model Student {

  lastName          String
  dateOfBirth       DateTime?
  gender            Gender?
  phone             String?
  address           String?
  photo             String?
  registrationNumber String  @unique

  enrollmentDate    DateTime @default(now())

  notes            Note[]

  parents          StudentParent[]

model Parent {

  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])

  user            User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  lastName        String
  phone           String?
  email           String?
  address         String?
  occupation      String?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)

model StudentParent {

  parent    Parent  @relation(fields: [parentId], references: [id])

}

model StudentClassAssignment {

  studentId       String
  student         Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  classId         String
  class           Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  academicYearId  String
  academicYear    AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  isPromoted      Boolean?
  assignedAt      DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([studentId, academicYearId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([classId])
  @@index([academicYearId])
}

model Teacher {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  userId          String?  @unique
  user            User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  firstName       String
  lastName        String
  phone           String?
  email           String?
  address         String?
  photo           String?
  specialization  String?
  hireDate        DateTime @default(now())
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  contracts     TeacherContract[]
  attendances   TeacherAttendance[]
  matieres      TeacherMatiere[]
  sessions      Session[]
  leaves        TeacherLeave[]
  schedules     ClassSchedule[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model TeacherMatiere {
  id        String @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId String
  teacher   Teacher @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  matiereId String
  matiere   Matiere @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([teacherId, matiereId])
}

model TeacherContract {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId       String
  teacher         Teacher  @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  contractType    ContractType
  startDate       DateTime
  endDate         DateTime?
  salary          Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  hourlyRate      Decimal? @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  monthlyHours    Int?
  paymentFormula  Json?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  description     String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  payments TeacherPayment[]

  @@index([teacherId])
}

model Employee {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  userId          String?  @unique
  user            User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  firstName       String
  lastName        String
  phone           String?
  email           String?
  position        String
  hireDate        DateTime @default(now())
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

enum RoomType {
  CLASSROOM
  LABORATORY
  LIBRARY
  GYM
  AUDITORIUM
  COMPUTER_LAB
  ART_ROOM
  MUSIC_ROOM
  OTHER

model Room {

  code            String?
  type            RoomType
  capacity        Int
  floor           Int?
  building        String?
  description     String?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)

  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  sessions  Session[]

model RoomEquipment {

  roomId   String

// ============================================================
// CALENDAR & SESSIONS
// ============================================================

enum DayOfWeek {
  MONDAY
  TUESDAY
  WEDNESDAY
  THURSDAY
  FRIDAY
  SATURDAY
  SUNDAY
}

enum SessionStatus {
  SCHEDULED
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
  CANCELLED
}

model ClassSchedule {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  classId     String
  class       Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  periodId    String
  period      AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  dayOfWeek   DayOfWeek
  startTime   DateTime
  endTime     DateTime
  matiereId   String?
  matiere     Matiere? @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  teacherId   String?
  teacher     Teacher? @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  roomId      String?
  room        Room?    @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id])
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  sessions Session[]

  @@index([classId])
  @@index([periodId])
  @@index([teacherId])
  @@index([roomId])
}

model Session {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  classId        String
  class          Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  scheduleId     String?
  schedule       ClassSchedule? @relation(fields: [scheduleId], references: [id])
  periodId       String
  period         AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  academicYearId String
  academicYear   AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  date           DateTime
  startTime      DateTime
  endTime        DateTime
  topic          String?
  notes          String?
  status         SessionStatus @default(SCHEDULED)
  teacherId      String?
  teacher        Teacher? @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  roomId         String?
  room           Room?    @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id])
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  attendances StudentAttendance[]
  lessons     Lesson[]

  @@index([classId])
  @@index([periodId])
  @@index([academicYearId])
  @@index([teacherId])
}

model Holiday {

  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  startDate       DateTime
  endDate         DateTime
  isRecurring     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

// ============================================================
// LESSONS, NOTES, EXAMS
// ============================================================

model Lesson {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  sessionId String
  session   Session  @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id])
  matiereId String
  matiere   Matiere  @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  title     String
  content   String?
  objectives String?
  resources Json?
  createdBy String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([sessionId])
  @@index([matiereId])
}

model Note {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId      String
  student        Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  matiereId      String
  matiere        Matiere  @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  periodId       String
  period         AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  academicYearId String
  academicYear   AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  examId         String?
  exam           Exam?    @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id])
  value          Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  maxValue       Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  coefficient    Decimal  @db.Decimal(3, 1)
  comment        String?
  gradedBy       String?
  gradedAt       DateTime @default(now())
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([studentId, matiereId, periodId, examId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([matiereId])
  @@index([periodId])
}

model Bulletin {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId     String
  student       Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  periodId      String
  period        AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  classId       String
  class         Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  totalScore    Decimal  @db.Decimal(6, 2)
  averageScore  Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  rank          Int?
  isPromoted    Boolean?
  comments      String?
  generatedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  generatedBy   String?

  @@unique([studentId, periodId, classId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([classId])
}

enum ExamType {
  QUIZ
  MIDTERM
  FINAL
  HOMEWORK
  PRACTICAL
  OTHER
}

enum ExamStatus {
  DRAFT
  SCHEDULED
  IN_PROGRESS
  COMPLETED
  GRADED
}

enum QuestionType {
  QCM
  FREE_TEXT
  FILE_UPLOAD
  TRUE_FALSE
  SHORT_ANSWER
}

enum SubmissionStatus {
  IN_PROGRESS
  SUBMITTED
  GRADED
  LATE
}

model Exam {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  classId         String
  class           Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  periodId        String
  period          AcademicPeriod @relation(fields: [periodId], references: [id])
  academicYearId  String
  academicYear    AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  matiereId       String
  matiere         Matiere  @relation(fields: [matiereId], references: [id])
  title           String
  description     String?
  type            ExamType
  isOnline        Boolean  @default(false)
  maxScore        Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(20)
  duration        Int?
  startTime       DateTime?
  endTime         DateTime?
  status          ExamStatus @default(DRAFT)
  antiCheat       Boolean  @default(false)
  maxAttempts     Int      @default(1)
  createdBy       String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  questions   ExamQuestion[]
  submissions ExamSubmission[]
  notes       Note[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
  @@index([classId])
  @@index([periodId])
  @@index([matiereId])
}

model ExamQuestion {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  examId    String
  exam      Exam     @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id])
  type      QuestionType
  content   String
  options   Json?
  maxScore  Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  sortOrder Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  answers ExamAnswer[]

  @@index([examId])
}

model ExamSubmission {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  examId      String
  exam        Exam     @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id])
  studentId   String
  student     Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  startedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  submittedAt DateTime?
  totalScore  Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  status      SubmissionStatus @default(IN_PROGRESS)
  ipAddress   String?
  tabSwitches Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  answers ExamAnswer[]

  @@unique([examId, studentId])
  @@index([studentId])
}

model ExamAnswer {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  submissionId String
  submission   ExamSubmission @relation(fields: [submissionId], references: [id])
  questionId   String
  question     ExamQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id])
  answer       String?
  fileUrl      String?
  score        Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  isCorrect    Boolean?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([submissionId])
  @@index([questionId])
}

// ============================================================
// ATTENDANCE
// ============================================================

enum AttendanceStatus {
  PRESENT
  ABSENT
  LATE
  EXCUSED
}

enum AttendanceSource {
  MANUAL
  AUTO_LOGIN
  QR_CODE
}

enum LeaveType {
  SICK
  PERSONAL
  VACATION
  MATERNITY
  OTHER
}

enum LeaveStatus {
  PENDING
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

model StudentAttendance {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId String
  student   Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  sessionId String
  session   Session  @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id])
  status    AttendanceStatus
  reason    String?
  markedBy  String?
  markedAt  DateTime @default(now())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([studentId, sessionId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([sessionId])
}

model TeacherAttendance {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId String
  teacher   Teacher  @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  date      DateTime
  checkIn   DateTime?
  checkOut  DateTime?
  status    AttendanceStatus
  source    AttendanceSource @default(MANUAL)
  markedBy  String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([teacherId, date])
  @@index([teacherId])
}

model TeacherLeave {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId String
  teacher   Teacher  @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  type      LeaveType
  startDate DateTime
  endDate   DateTime
  reason    String?
  status    LeaveStatus @default(PENDING)
  approvedBy String?
  approvedAt DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([teacherId])
}

// ============================================================
// PAYMENTS & FINANCE
// ============================================================

enum PaymentPlanType {
  ONE_TIME
  RECURRING
  ENROLLMENT
  TUITION
  CUSTOM
}

enum RecurringPeriod {
  MONTHLY
  QUARTERLY
  SEMESTER
  YEARLY
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  PARTIAL
  OVERDUE
  CANCELLED
  REFUNDED
}

enum CaisseType {
  MAIN
  TUITION
  SALARY
  PETTY_CASH
}

enum TransactionType {
  INCOME
  EXPENSE
  TRANSFER
  REFUND
  PENALTY
}

model PaymentPlan {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  description     String?
  classLevelId    String?
  classId         String?
  type            PaymentPlanType
  amount          Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  dueDate         DateTime?
  recurringPeriod RecurringPeriod?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  startDate       DateTime?
  endDate         DateTime?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  payments StudentPayment[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model StudentPayment {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId       String
  student         Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  parentId        String
  parent          Parent   @relation(fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  planId          String?
  plan            PaymentPlan? @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  amount          Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  method          PaymentMethod
  status          PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  dueDate         DateTime?
  paidAt          DateTime?
  reference       String?
  stripePaymentId String?
  paypalPaymentId String?
  checkNumber     String?
  notes           String?
  penaltyAmount   Decimal? @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  createdBy       String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([parentId])
  @@index([planId])
}

model TeacherPayment {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  teacherId       String
  teacher         Teacher  @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  contractId      String
  contract        TeacherContract @relation(fields: [contractId], references: [id])
  period          String
  amount          Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  hoursWorked     Decimal? @db.Decimal(6, 2)
  calculatedAmount Decimal @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  status          PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  paidAt          DateTime?
  notes           String?
  createdBy       String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([teacherId])
  @@index([contractId])
}

model Caisse {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  name            String
  type            CaisseType
  balance         Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2) @default(0)
  currency        String   @default("DZD")
  description     String?
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  transactions FinancialTransaction[]

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model FinancialTransaction {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  caisseId      String
  caisse        Caisse   @relation(fields: [caisseId], references: [id])
  type          TransactionType
  amount        Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  balance       Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  category      String?
  description   String?
  referenceId   String?
  referenceType String?
  performedBy   String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([caisseId])
  @@index([type])
}

model ProfitLoss {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  period          String
  totalIncome     Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2) @default(0)
  totalExpenses   Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2) @default(0)
  netProfit       Decimal  @db.Decimal(12, 2) @default(0)
  calculatedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([establishmentId, period])
  @@index([establishmentId])
}

// ============================================================
// MESSAGING & NOTIFICATIONS
// ============================================================

enum ConversationType {
  DIRECT
  GROUP
  ANNOUNCEMENT
}

enum MessageType {
  TEXT
  IMAGE
  FILE
  SYSTEM
}

enum NotificationType {
  IN_APP
  EMAIL
  SMS
}

model Conversation {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  title     String?
  type      ConversationType @default(DIRECT)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  participants ConversationParticipant[]
  messages     Message[]
}

model ConversationParticipant {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  conversationId  String
  conversation    Conversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id])
  userId          String
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  joinedAt        DateTime @default(now())
  lastReadAt      DateTime?

  @@unique([conversationId, userId])
  @@index([conversationId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Message {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  conversationId  String
  conversation    Conversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id])
  senderId        String
  sender          User     @relation("Sender", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  receiverId      String?
  receiver        User?    @relation("Receiver", fields: [receiverId], references: [id])
  content         String
  type            MessageType @default(TEXT)
  fileUrl         String?
  isRead          Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([conversationId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@index([receiverId])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  title     String
  content   String
  type      NotificationType
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false)
  link      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
}

model NotificationTemplate {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  code      String   @unique
  name      String
  subject   String?
  body      String
  type      NotificationType
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

// ============================================================
// AUDIT & GRADUATION
// ============================================================

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String?
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String
  entity    String
  entityId  String?
  oldValues Json?
  newValues Json?
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([entity, entityId])
  @@index([action])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model GraduationConfig {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String
  establishment   Establishment @relation(fields: [establishmentId], references: [id])
  classId         String
  class           Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  minAverageToPass Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2) @default(10)
  autoPromote     Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([establishmentId, classId])
}

model GraduationRecord {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  studentId      String
  student        Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  fromClassId    String
  fromClass      Class    @relation("FromClass", fields: [fromClassId], references: [id])
  toClassId      String?
  toClass        Class?   @relation("ToClass", fields: [toClassId], references: [id])
  academicYearId String
  academicYear   AcademicYear @relation(fields: [academicYearId], references: [id])
  averageScore   Decimal  @db.Decimal(5, 2)
  isPromoted     Boolean
  reason         String?
  processedBy    String?
  processedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([studentId, academicYearId])
  @@index([studentId])
  @@index([fromClassId])
  @@index([academicYearId])
}

## Objective
- Building **BSofts School**, a comprehensive multi-tenant SaaS school management system handling students, teachers, parents, employees, academics, payments, exams, attendance, messaging, and finance.
- Tech stack: PostgreSQL 17, Prisma, NestJS (backend), Next.js + Tailwind CSS (frontend), with `backend/` and `frontend/` as separate folders in `E:\ReFactory\BSofts-School`.

## Important Details
- **Database URL**: `postgresql://postgres:admin@127.0.0.1:5432/bsoftsschool?schema=public`
- **Multi-tenancy**: Shared tables with `tenantId` filtering (not separate schemas)
- **Roles**: Root (developer/platform owner), Super Admin (establishment owner), Admin, Employee (office staff), Teacher, Student, Parent
- **Auth guard chain**: `JwtAuthGuard` → `SubscriptionMiddleware` (checks tenant subscription) → `PermissionsGuard` (checks role permissions against plan modules). ROOT user bypasses all.
- **JWT payload**: `{ userId, email, establishmentId?, tenantId?, isRoot }`
- **Frontend**: Single dynamic dashboard that adapts based on role + permissions (not separate route groups per role)
- **Establishment switcher**: Dropdown in header for Root users (JWT-based establishment context)
- **Establishment categories**: Daycare, School, Middle School, High School, University
- **Academic hierarchy**: Academic Year → Period (Trimester/Semester, configurable per class level) → Class → Module → Matière → Lesson/Exam/Note
- **Grading**: Fully configurable per establishment (numeric 0-20, letter A-F, percentage, custom), coefficient-weighted final grades
- **Payments**: Configurable plans (one-time/recurring), methods include Stripe/PayPal/Cash/Check, penalties configurable
- **Teacher contracts**: Hourly, monthly, yearly, per formation, custom with JSON payment formulas
- **Exams**: Online optional per establishment, QCM/free text/file upload, optional anti-cheating
- **Messaging**: In-app only, role-based permissions for who can message whom
- **SMTP**: Configurable per establishment via database table
- **File storage**: Local disk (`uploads/` directory)
- **No Docker**: All local development

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"

// ============================================================
// SAAS PLATFORM

enum PlanInterval {
  MONTHLY
  YEARLY
  LIFETIME
}

enum SubscriptionStatus {
  ACTIVE
  SUSPENDED
  CANCELLED
  EXPIRED
}

model SaaSPlan {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String   @unique
  description String?
  price       Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency    String   @default("DZD")
  interval    PlanInterval
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  modules       SaaSPlanModule[]
  features      SaaSPlanFeature[]
  subscriptions TenantSubscription[]
}

model SaaSModule {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String   @unique
  code        String   @unique
  description String?
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  plans       SaaSPlanModule[]
  permissions SaaSPermission[]
}

model SaaSPermission {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  moduleId    String
  module      SaaSModule  @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])
  name        String
  code        String   @unique
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  rolePermissions RolePermission[]
}

model SaaSPlanModule {
  planId   String
  plan     SaaSPlan   @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  moduleId String
  module   SaaSModule @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([planId, moduleId])
}

model SaaSPlanFeature {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  planId      String
  plan        SaaSPlan @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  code        String
  value       String
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([planId, code])
}

model TenantSubscription {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId    String
  tenant      Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id])
  planId      String
  plan        SaaSPlan @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  status      SubscriptionStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  startDate   DateTime
  endDate     DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

## Progress Summary

### ✅ Sprints Completed

| Sprint | Status | Backend |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Sprint 0 | ✅ Complete | Prisma schema, migrations, seed, base utilities |
| Sprint 1 | ✅ Complete | Auth, Users, Roles, Permissions, Login Logs |
| Sprint 2 | ✅ Complete | SaaS Plans, SaaS Modules, Tenant Subscriptions |
| Sprint 3 | ✅ Complete | Tenants, Establishments |

### Backend API Endpoints

**Auth & Users**
- `POST /api/auth/login` - User login
- `POST /api/auth/register` - User registration
- `GET /api/auth/profile` - Get current user
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/users` - User CRUD

**Roles & Permissions**
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/roles` - Role CRUD
- `GET/POST/DELETE /api/permissions` - Permission CRUD
- `POST/DELETE /api/user-roles` - Assign/remove roles
- `POST/DELETE /api/role-permissions` - Assign/remove permissions

**SaaS Platform**
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/saas-plans` - Plan CRUD
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/saas-modules` - Module CRUD
- `GET/POST/PUT /api/tenant-subscriptions` - Subscription CRUD

**Tenants & Establishments**
- `GET/POST/DELETE /api/tenants` - Tenant CRUD
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/establishments` - Establishment CRUD

### Seed Data Created
- 23 SaaS modules
- 161 permissions
- 4 plans (Free, Basic, Premium, Enterprise)
- 6 system roles (Super Admin, Admin, Employee, Teacher, Student, Parent)
- 15 class levels (PS to Terminale)
- 1 super admin user: `admin@bsofts.com` / `Admin@123`

### Next Steps

1. **Sprint 4**: Academic Structure (Academic Year, Period, Class, Module, Matière)
2. **Sprint 5**: People Management (Students, Parents, Teachers, Employees)

model TeacherContract {

  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  payments TeacherPayment[]

  @@index([teacherId])
}

model Employee {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  establishmentId String

  position        String
  hireDate        DateTime @default(now())

  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([establishmentId])
}

model Conversation {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  title     String?
  type      ConversationType @default(DIRECT)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  participants ConversationParticipant[]
  messages     Message[]
}

model ConversationParticipant {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  conversationId  String
  conversation    Conversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id])
  userId          String
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  joinedAt        DateTime @default(now())
  lastReadAt      DateTime?

  @@unique([conversationId, userId])
  @@index([conversationId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Message {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  conversationId  String
  conversation    Conversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id])
  senderId        String
  sender          User     @relation("Sender", fields: [senderId], references: [id])
  receiverId      String?
  receiver        User?    @relation("Receiver", fields: [receiverId], references: [id])
  content         String
  type            MessageType @default(TEXT)
  fileUrl         String?
  isRead          Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([conversationId])
  @@index([senderId])
  @@index([receiverId])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  title     String
  content   String
  type      NotificationType
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false)
  link      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
}

model NotificationTemplate {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  code      String   @unique
  name      String
  subject   String?
  body      String
  type      NotificationType
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

// ============================================================
// AUDIT & GRADUATION
// ============================================================

model AuditLog {

  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String
  entity    String

## Objective
- Building **BSofts School**, a comprehensive multi-tenant SaaS school management system handling students, teachers, parents, employees, academics, payments, exams, attendance, messaging, and finance.
- Tech stack: PostgreSQL 17, Prisma 7, NestJS (backend), Next.js + Tailwind CSS (frontend), with `backend/` and `frontend/` as separate folders in `E:\ReFactory\BSofts-School`.

## Important Details
- **Database URL**: `postgresql://postgres:admin@127.0.0.1:5432/bsoftsschool?schema=public`
- **Multi-tenancy**: Shared tables with `tenantId` filtering (not separate schemas)
- **Roles**: Root (developer/platform owner), Super Admin (establishment owner), Admin, Employee (office staff), Teacher, Student, Parent
- **Auth guard chain**: `JwtAuthGuard` → `SubscriptionMiddleware` → `PermissionsGuard`. ROOT user bypasses all.
- **JWT payload**: `{ userId, email, establishmentId?, tenantId?, isRoot }`
- **Frontend**: Single dynamic dashboard adapting based on role + permissions
- **Prisma 7 specifics**: Requires `@prisma/adapter-pg` driver adapter for PrismaClient instantiation; `url` goes in `prisma.config.ts` via `datasource: { url: env('DATABASE_URL') }` (not in schema); `import 'dotenv/config'` must be at top of `prisma.config.ts`

model SaaSModule {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String   @unique
  code        String   @unique
  description String?
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  plans       SaaSPlanModule[]
  permissions SaaSPermission[]
}

model SaaSPermission {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  moduleId    String
  module      SaaSModule  @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])
  name        String
  code        String   @unique
  description String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  rolePermissions RolePermission[]
}

model SaaSPlanModule {
  planId   String
  plan     SaaSPlan   @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  moduleId String
  module   SaaSModule @relation(fields: [moduleId], references: [id])

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([planId, moduleId])
}

model SaaSPlanFeature {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  planId      String
  plan        SaaSPlan @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  code        String
  value       String
  description String?

### Backend
- **127 API endpoints**
- **30+ modules**
- **45+ Prisma models**
- **58 unit tests**

### Frontend
- **12 pages**: Landing, Login, Register, Dashboard, Students, Teachers, Classes, Attendance, Exams, Payments, Settings
- **UI Components**: Button, Input, Card
- **Layout**: Sidebar, Header
- **State Management**: Zustand
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS

### Frontend Routes
```
/                    - Landing page
/login               - Login page
/register            - Register page
/dashboard           - Dashboard with stats
/students            - Student management
/teachers            - Teacher management
/classes             - Class management
/attendance          - Attendance tracking
/exams               - Exam management
/payments            - Payment management
/settings            - User settings
```

2. **Sprint 18**: Add charts/reports visualization
3. **Sprint 19**: Add real-time notifications (WebSocket)
4. **Sprint 20**: Deploy to production
